project.title: Bird community of Experiment 3 (First three PCR replicates) "Advancing airborne eDNA sampling methods for monitoring diverse terrestrial vertebrate communities"
project.description: These sequence files includes the first three PCR replicates (out of 6 replicates) of the bird community dataset generated with BirT primers (Thalinger et al. BirT: A Novel Primer Pair for Avian Environmental DNA Metabarcoding. Environmental DNA e70255 (2026)) in the Experiment 3 (from Lille Vildmose nature area in Denmark) of "Advancing airborne eDNA sampling methods for monitoring diverse terrestrial vertebrate communities".
